description: Check O-auto-joint-continuation with a generated joint-change and failed-transfer prefix, then a deterministic fair periodic suffix. Compare complete reachable protocol state at drained points ten ticks apart; equality with continuing joint AutoLeave and no leave proposal is the local closed-cycle witness. Twenty warm-up ticks select a stable comparison phase, not a deadline.

harness.description: Single-threaded three-node RawNode scheduler. No target changes, forged responses or concurrent observations. Transient TimeoutNow loss; apply-before-Advance throughout. Reflection serializes all fields recursively, including storage data, logs, pending queues, progress, inflights, timers, function identities, read tracking and RawNode completion state; it omits only output-only loggers and MemoryStorage mutex/call-count instrumentation. State values are retained directly, without hashes. Empty slice capacity and pointer allocation identity are not protocol state. All scheduler queues and outstanding Ready work are empty at comparison points. Corrected active_result reads raft.trk.Config.AutoLeave directly under sole driver ownership; status_auto_leave remains a diagnostic.
semantic_changes: Replace physical transport/storage with a deterministic in-process network and MemoryStorage.

Record read-only recursive protocol state; omit logger/traceLogger, MemoryStorage.Mutex and MemoryStorage.callStats because execution is single-threaded and these do not determine the next protocol transition.
Corrected active_result samples the live AutoLeave flag instead of the Status.Config copy; retains status_auto_leave separately.

legality.derivation: Three serialized RawNodes use MemoryStorage and an explicit initial snapshot. Elect leader 1 with actual votes; propose JointImplicit removal of voter 3. Persist each Ready before exposing its messages, apply committed configurations in order, and Advance each batch. On leader application of the joint entry, start transfer to voter 2 before Advance; this preserves all caller duties and allows protocol activity during an outstanding Ready. Drop only TimeoutNow during this transient attempt. After ten configured election ticks, require the original leader and cleared transfer; all subsequent ticks and messages are delivered, all Ready work drained. Read state only under single-thread ownership.
legality.applicability: One fixed scenario identity with implicit joint change, completed application, aborted transfer, stable term/roles and no new proposals during the principal observation.
alternatives: A normal completion or later proposal may trigger automatic leave; the post-observation rescue records that separately.

grounding.derivation: Result refers to the same scenario/leader/joint-entry identity as admission. closed_joint_cycle is computed from exact encoded state equality, remaining joint AutoLeave, and unchanged leave proposal count. The suffix checks stable term/roles after ticks and protocol mutations, ticks all nodes in a fixed order and drains all storage/network work. Global election randomness is unreachable while the observed suffix preserves roles and each follower receives heartbeats each tick; randomizedElectionTimeout itself is captured. No timeout or finite lack of output alone produces the witness.
grounding.applicability: Only the principal result, before the separately tagged diagnostic rescue.
unresolved: Current execution and semantic correspondence must establish actual recurrence and sufficiency of excluded instrumentation fields.

observable_properties.description: The admitted automatic-exit operation must not exhibit a closed repeating protocol cycle retaining joint AutoLeave and producing no leave proposal. A false closed-cycle observation only means this particular witness was not obtained; it is not universal progress proof.

uncertainties: A nonrepeating finite window does not establish nontermination or a missed deadline.
The finite recurrence justifies an indefinitely repeatable suffix only if the correspondence review validates captured state and the fixed scheduler.
The post-result client proposal changes the input policy and is diagnostic only.
